title: Fulfilment method (modality + who-organizes)
description: How the order is fulfilled. Single canonical enum that captures both the modality (consume-onsite / pickup / delivery) AND the who-organizes-the-fulfiller dimension (buyer-assigned / seller-assigned / dutch-auction). Generic across local-commerce verticals (food, retail, services).

fields.name: method
fields.description: Fulfilment method. consume-onsite = no movement (on-premise consumption). pickup = buyer organizes pickup. deliver:buyer-assigned = delivery, buyer chooses courier. deliver:seller-assigned = delivery, merchant arranges courier directly. deliver:dutch-auction = delivery, courier selected via Dutch auction.
